name: Roy Alfred DeLechien
source:
He is the butler in Darling's family and Wendy's fencing teacher.

Roy has been taking care of Wendy since she was five after her nanny, who is also his mother, died of illness. Because they have been together since their childhood, he is much like an older brother figure to Wendy.
